fusions.name: Snag the Straggler
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A barbed bite that deals 22 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Sweep
fusions.desc: A raking snap through a cone 3 tiles ahead of you deals 4 damage to everything caught in it, each with a 20% chance of [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drag Into the Circle
fusions.desc: Sets a catching point 5 tiles across ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught and Kept
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 10% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
